sal.basis: Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, 8 yrs, London, base salary (bonus excluded). Robert Half 2026 guide, FP&A Analyst, Greater London: P25 £60.5k, median £68.5k, P75 £78.5k. Learnsignal 2026: senior financial analyst (4-7 yrs) median £62k; senior FP&A analyst median £68k. Payscale London senior financial analyst average about £54.5k (all experience levels). Hays London listing Aug 2025: £60-65k. Chosen current base of about £62.5k a year (£5,200 a month); f = 5,200 / 26,000 = 0.20. Noura's 34,000 SAR expectation maps to about £81.5k, near the Robert Half P75, which suits an ACCA-qualified 8-year analyst aiming for a senior FP&A role.

sensitive.notes: UK CVs and application forms leave out photo, date of birth, nationality and marital status; the Equality Act 2010 protects age, sex, race (incl. nationality), and marriage and civil partnership, so asking invites bias claims. Right to work is checked separately (passport, or share code for everyone else) and is covered by the rights card, not a nationality field. Many ATS forms add a voluntary equal-opportunities monitoring section (gender, ethnicity, disability, age band) that is kept apart from selection and always allows 'Prefer not to say'; it is not required, so we do not ask. If the product later wants to fill these forms, 'eeo' is the closest mode.

privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par le RGPD britannique (UK GDPR) et le Data Protection Act 2018, et vous pouvez les télécharger ou les supprimer à tout moment.

renewal.en: Renews automatically until you cancel, which you can do any time in Settings. Under UK consumer law you can cancel within 14 days of buying for a refund, minus any service already provided.

renewal.fr: Renouvellement automatique jusqu'à résiliation, possible à tout moment depuis les Paramètres. Selon le droit britannique de la consommation, vous pouvez annuler sous 14 jours après l'achat et être remboursé, déduction faite du service déjà fourni.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in London. I lead IFRS and FRS 102 reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in London or hybrid.

Je pilote le reporting IFRS et FRS 102 et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une équipe finance de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et je recherche un poste d'analyste financière senior ou en FP&A à Londres ou en hybride.

culture.notes: Work week Mon-Fri, about 37.5 hours; hybrid (2-3 office days) is the norm for London finance roles. Salaries are quoted gross per year, often 'plus bonus and benefits' (workplace pension auto-enrolment is standard). Pay is monthly, usually on the last working day or a fixed date around the 25th-28th. Notice is contractual: typically 1 month for analysts, 3 months for managers and at Big-4 firms and banks (the statutory minimum for an employee who resigns is only 1 week), and recruiters ask for it up front. CVs: 2 A4 pages, reverse-chronological, short personal profile at the top, no photo, date of birth, marital status or nationality; references are taken after an offer, so 'references available on request' is not needed. Cover letters are optional on most ATS and LinkedIn applications, but the public sector expects a supporting statement (Civil Service Success Profiles, competency-based). Qualification status ('ACCA/CIMA/ACA qualified' or 'part-qualified') is a standard screening question. Specialist agencies (Hays, Robert Half, Michael Page, Morgan McKinley) fill a large share of FP&A roles. A right-to-work check (passport or share code) happens before day one.
